top_findings: Zero Schema.org JSON-LD structured data across all 10 pages, missing SoftwareApplication and Article rich results.
Missing robots.txt and sitemap.xml, leaving search and AI crawlers without discovery or indexing boundaries.
Missing canonical tags on all pages, risking link equity fragmentation across deployment mirrors.
All 5 resource articles share the unoptimized title 'PenseeWeb Studio' and have null meta descriptions.
OpenGraph and Twitter preview images use relative paths and AVIF format, breaking link cards on WhatsApp and Twitter.
quick_wins: Deploy custom robots.txt with dedicated AI crawler directives and sitemap declaration.
Generate valid sitemap.xml with accurate W3C timestamps for all 10 pages.
Inject rich JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication with INR pricing, and Article schemas).
Inject self-referencing canonical links and optimized title/description tags on every page.
Deploy llms.txt and llms-full.txt for instant ChatGPT Search and Perplexity citation.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fully server-rendered static HTML ensures 100% crawl accessibility without JS execution requirements.
Clean, semantic modern layout using Webflow framework components.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt
findings.description: Root robots.txt returns 404, omitting crawler instructions and sitemap discovery.
findings.recommendation: Deploy robots.txt specifying Googlebot, Bingbot, AI crawler access, and sitemap URL.

findings.title: Missing sitemap.xml
findings.description: No XML sitemap is present to guide indexing priority and content modification times.
findings.recommendation: Generate W3C-compliant sitemap.xml listing all 10 core pages and articles.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tags
findings.description: Zero pages define <link rel='canonical'>, risking duplicate content across Netlify and GitHub Pages.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical tags to all 10 HTML documents.

findings.title: Multiple H1 Tags Per Document
findings.description: Bottom CTA banners are coded as <h1> tags, diluting primary topical relevance.

categories.name: Content Quality & On-Page SEO
what_works: Highly engaging copy tailored to Indian competitive exam culture (Kota, JEE, NEET, UPSC, CA).
Clear pricing transparency (₹9 pay-per-map to ₹350/month Pro tier).

findings.title: Blank / Generic Metadata on Resource Articles
findings.description: All 5 resource articles have title 'PenseeWeb Studio' and null meta descriptions.
findings.recommendation: Inject unique 50-60 character titles and 140-160 character meta descriptions.

findings.title: Meta Description Truncation on Core Pages
findings.description: Homepage, About, and Product descriptions exceed 240-310 characters and get truncated.
findings.recommendation: Condense meta descriptions to under 160 characters with clear call-to-action.

findings.title: Leaked Text in Resources Hub Description
findings.description: resources.html meta description contains 'Open Graph Settings' export artifact.
findings.recommendation: Remove leaked string and provide focused snippet text.

findings.title: Internal '[ARCHIVE]' Marker in Careers H1
findings.description: careers.html H1 heading displays '[ARCHIVE] Join the Mindmap Rebellion'.

findings.title: Total Absence of Schema.org JSON-LD
findings.description: 0 out of 10 pages have structured data, preventing Google Rich Snippets.
findings.recommendation: Deploy Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, and Article JSON-LD.

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Static page load with low JS execution keeps INP under 120ms.
Hero visuals use high-compression AVIF images.

findings.title: Synchronous WebFont Loader in Head
findings.description: webfont.js executes synchronously in <head>, blocking First Contentful Paint.
findings.recommendation: Ensure font display swap and preload key styles.

findings.title: Cumulative Layout Shift on Unsized Images
findings.description: Feature cards lack height dimensions, causing reflow during image load.
findings.recommendation: Provide explicit dimension or aspect-ratio attributes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & GEO
what_works: Unique terminology and strong domain relevance in Indian EdTech space.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and llms-full.txt
findings.description: AI models lack a standardized markdown context map for documentation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy standard llms.txt and llms-full.txt specification files.

findings.title: Unspecified AI Crawler Policies
findings.description: No explicit permission given to ChatGPT Search, Claude Search, or Perplexity bots.
findings.recommendation: Add allow directives for OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot in robots.txt.

categories.name: Image SEO
what_works: AVIF adoption across 90%+ of graphic assets.
Responsive srcset used on major hero diagrams.

findings.title: Incompatible OpenGraph Image Format and Path
findings.description: og:image points to relative AVIF file; social crawlers require absolute JPG/PNG.
findings.recommendation: Update og:image and twitter:image to absolute URLs with JPG/PNG support.

findings.title: Empty Alt Attributes on Editorial Images

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes & Infrastructure
items: Deploy production robots.txt with AI bot policies and sitemap reference.
Deploy XML sitemap (sitemap.xml) with full URL list and W3C dates.
Deploy llms.txt and llms-full.txt for Generative Engine Optimization.
Inject self-referencing canonical tags into all 10 pages.

phases.name: Phase 2: Structured Data & Rich Results
items: Embed Organization, WebSite, and SoftwareApplication (INR pricing) JSON-LD on homepage.
Embed Article and NewsArticle JSON-LD on all 5 resource articles.

phases.name: Phase 3: On-Page Metadata & Content Tuning
items: Fix titles and meta descriptions across all 5 resource articles.
Clean up 'Open Graph Settings' string leakage in resources.html.
Condense homepage, about, and product meta descriptions to under 160 chars.
Resolve multiple H1 issues across pages and remove [ARCHIVE] from Careers.

phases.name: Phase 4: Social Previews & Performance Polish
items: Update og:image and twitter:image to fully qualified absolute paths.
Fix newsletter privacy policy anchor link to point to privacy page.
